content.intro: Learn static, media, and deployment failures through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Static, Media, and Deployment Failures matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines static, media, and deployment failures as part of troubleshooting and legacy compatibility. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: Static file discovery; Missing MEDIA_ROOT or STATIC_ROOT configuration; Storage permission problems; Incorrect proxy configuration; Environment variable mismatches. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.

items.title: Missing MEDIA_ROOT or STATIC_ROOT configuration
items.text: Configuration for Missing MEDIA_ROOT or STATIC_ROOT configuration should be explicit, environment-aware, and validated before serving requests. Record defaults and deploy-specific values, keep secrets outside committed content, and test the setting that changes behavior.

items.title: Storage permission problems
items.text: Storage permission problems is a server-side responsibility where applicable. Define who may perform the action and on which object, validate untrusted input, test denied cases, and document sensitive-data handling.

content_blocks.title: Worked example: Static, Media, and Deployment Failures
content_blocks.expected_output: Static files are collected into the configured STATIC_ROOT for the deployment’s serving strategy.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Open a local project using the documented Django 6.1-compatible Python environment. If this snippet depends on model names, URL configuration, settings, or an optional package, add those prerequisites before running it. Otherwise inspect it as a static example. content_blocks.troubleshooting: Configure STATIC_ROOT and a static host/storage strategy. User media is not the same as static assets.

content_blocks.title: Try it yourself
content_blocks.text: Change one input or configuration choice related to Static file discovery. Write down the expected outcome, test one normal case and one invalid or boundary case, then record what changed. Do not add real credentials or sensitive production data.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Common pitfalls include skipping a required configuration/import, copying a fragment without its model or URL context, trusting client input, or treating a development-only behavior as production-ready. Check the earliest failing assumption, consult the version-specific docs, and add a regression test for the failure you found.

content_blocks.title: Recap
